editorial_principle: Each field is a perceptual rule-set. In Naples it keeps incompatible readings on identical coordinates, where the sacred and the profane share the same ground. A field does not describe the city; it sets the conditions under which the city becomes readable.

fields.label: coincidenza_sacro_profano
fields.basho: urban space holds sacred and profane readings on identical coordinates without separation
fields.kokyu: perception moves between reverence and everyday use without a transition marker
fields.activation_condition: presence of a site read simultaneously as sacred and profane
fields.persistence_rule: field remains active while both readings share the same ground
fields.dissolution_rule: field collapses only if one register is fully expelled from the site
fields.textual_anchor_it: la sua bellezza è insita in un mix di sacro e profano che la rende una città unica al mondo.

fields.label: voce_di_partenope
fields.basho: narrative position coincides with the city itself; perception issues from a voice that claims to be everything and nothing
fields.kokyu: temporal synchronization runs from before the city's foundation into its present without a defined origin
fields.activation_condition: single first-person voice that is not external to what it describes
fields.persistence_rule: field persists while the narrating voice remains unidentifiable
fields.dissolution_rule: field dissolves if the voice resolves into a locatable speaker
fields.textual_anchor_it: sono tutto questo e niente, ma soprattutto Napoli.

fields.label: attesa_non_verificabile
fields.basho: urban space organizes around a sign whose truth cannot be established
fields.kokyu: perceptual rhythm returns at fixed intervals to the same expectation without reaching certainty
fields.activation_condition: presence of a recurring collective sign held without verification
fields.persistence_rule: field remains active while the expectation is renewed rather than confirmed
fields.dissolution_rule: field stabilizes only if the sign becomes verifiable
fields.textual_anchor_it: Sulla figura di Gennaro si sa poco

fields.label: stratificazione_sovrapposta
fields.basho: urban space contains coexisting historical layers surfaced by excavation without erasure
fields.kokyu: time operates through simultaneous stratification rather than linear succession
fields.activation_condition: presence of multi-epoch layers made co-perceptible by digging
fields.persistence_rule: field remains active while the buried layers stay readable under the surface
fields.dissolution_rule: field dissolves if the layers collapse into a single chronology
fields.textual_anchor_it: altri sono stati rinvenuti durante gli scavi della metropolitana

system_note.system_behavior: fields operate as persistent perceptual operators over urban reading conditions
